ModMetaData.name: TailorMade: Race Restriction Fix [种族限制修复]
ModMetaData.author: deepseek
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]TailorMade: Race Restriction Fix[/h1] [i]修复 TailorMade 的 unlockRestrictedApparel 开关无效的问题[/i]
[h2]The Bug / 问题[/h2] TailorMade's XML patch unconditionally deletes HAR race restriction data at load time, making the "unlockRestrictedApparel" toggle a dead switch. [i]TailorMade 的 XML 补丁在加载时强制删除 HAR 种族服装限制数据，导致设置开关形同虚设。[/i]
[h2]The Fix / 修复[/h2] [list] [*]Properly respects the unlockRestrictedApparel setting at runtime [*]When OFF: restricts cross-race clothing based on recovered race data [*]When ON: behaves identically to TailorMade's original behavior [*]Safe to use, easy to remove — no TailorMade files are modified [/list] [i]运行时正确响应开关状态。关闭时恢复跨种族服装限制，开启时与 TailorMade 原行为一致。不修改任何 TailorMade 文件。[/i]
[h2]Installation / 安装[/h2] Place this mod AFTER TailorMade in your mod list. [i]将此模组排在 TailorMade 之后。[/i]
